Methodology: Lasso regression (α=0.9, 10-year window) maps 13 factor/style ETF ratios vs SPY to each FX rate. Residual = (actual − model) / actual × 100. Positive residual → currency overvalued relative to factor signals; negative → undervalued.
Factors: MTUM (Momentum), SPHB (High Beta), IWC (Micro Cap), IVW (LG Growth), IJT (SC Growth), IJR (Small Cap), IJS (SC Value), IJK (MC Growth), QUAL (Quality), IJJ (MC Value), VYM (High Div), IVE (LG Value), USMV (Min Vol).

AI Commentary · google/gemma-4-31B-it · 2026-06-24 21:55 UTC
Value and high-dividend factors proxy global risk appetite and carry-trade flows, where strength in these styles signals a "risk-on" environment favoring high-beta EM currencies like BRL. The -10.0% residual indicates USDBRL is trading significantly below its factor-implied equilibrium, suggesting the Real is fundamentally overvalued or the USD is temporarily undersold relative to equity risk premiums. This divergence implies a mean-reversion catalyst is required to close the gap toward the 5.6854 fair value.
